The description omits that the x-axis is a categorical interval scale.
The description does not explicitly mention the line style (solid line) for both networks.
The description does not explicitly mention the line style (solid line) for the '随机网络'.

The value at B1 (4.030) is not the lowest value for '随机网络'; the description omits that the value rises again after B1.
The description omits the exact values for A2 (3.278), B2 (3.235), C1 (3.304), and C2 (3.420) for '中介网络'.
The description omits the exact values for A2 (4.233), B2 (4.188), C1 (4.265), and C2 (4.613) for '随机网络'.
